One real run, step by step. A metformin dosing question submitted from Studio: the parent query plus two sub-queries fan out to retrieve_documents, the evaluator asks for one gap-fill round, then one generation, validation, follow-ups and finalize with the cited answer in state. 16 seconds end to end. This per-node view, plus thread history and cancel/rollback, is the developer experience that decision D10 bought.

The coach graph wraps it. The coach assistant, captured 2026-08-26: a deterministic coach_gate routes to short_circuit, document/reminder nodes, erasure, or the single coach_agent. The whole RAG StateGraph on the left lives inside that agent as its medical_lookup tool (return_direct) — here a “can my sister take my atorvastatin” question is relayed into it and the gate’s personal-advice refusal comes straight back through finalize, unparaphrased, with follow_ups [].
